name: Skill request
about: Propose a new skill or an improvement to an existing one
title: ''

---

**The job to be done**
What are you trying to accomplish? Describe the task, not the implementation
— "turn a folder of call recordings into a synthesis doc", not "add X flag".

**Which pack does it belong to?**
context / dev / pm / writing / research / media / messaging — or a new one?

**What exists today**
How do you do this now (manual steps, another tool, an existing skill that
almost fits)?

**Constraints worth knowing**
Credentials it would need, platform limits (macOS-only tooling, network),
anything that runs unattended.
